tiktokLive.title: TikTok Live Recorder
tiktokLive.subtitle: Inspect and record TikTok Live streams with your Youwee browser authentication.

input.placeholder: Enter @username, room ID, or TikTok Live URL...
input.label: TikTok Live username, room ID, or URL

presets.originDescription: Recommended. Prioritizes the highest source resolution and quality, including 60 FPS when offered at that tier.
presets.prefer60Description: Prioritizes TikTok’s 60 FPS tier, even at a lower resolution; falls back to the best available stream.
presets.audioDescription: Records sound without video to reduce the output file size.
presets.customDurationHelp: Set hours, minutes, and seconds. Example: 1 h 30 m 5 s.

status.notLive: This TikTok Live is not active.
status.refreshingStream: Refreshing the TikTok Live stream URL ({{attempt}}/{{total}})...
status.recorded: Recording saved and added to Library.
status.partialSaved: The stream ended after reconnect attempts. The partial recording was saved.

autoReconnect.label: Auto-reconnect
autoReconnect.description: Keep recording through temporary network or stream interruptions.

watchlist.title: Watchlist
watchlist.description: Monitor TikTok accounts and automatically record when they go live.
watchlist.empty: Use the current target and recording rules above to add your first watchlist entry.
watchlist.added: TikTok Live account added to the watchlist.
watchlist.deleted: Watchlist entry removed. Existing recordings were not deleted.

errors.recordingRecoverable: Recording stopped with recoverable media. Continue or finalize it below.
errors.recordingFailed: Recording failed. Youwee will check again later.
errors.recordingBusy: Another TikTok Live recording is active. This account will be checked again.
errors.metadataFailed: Metadata check failed. See Logs for details.
errors.restartRecoverable: Recording was interrupted and can be continued or finalized.
errors.missingJob: The previous recording job was not found. Youwee will check again.

deleteDialog.title: Remove from watchlist?
deleteDialog.description: Stop monitoring “{{target}}”? Existing recordings and recovery files are kept.

watchlist.recorderLimitUpdated: TikTok Live recorder room limit updated.

schedule.description: Only auto-record this streamer during the selected local days and time range.

recovery.title: Interrupted recordings
recovery.description: Recover recordings that were active when Youwee closed unexpectedly.
recovery.finalized: Recovered recording finalized and added to Library.
recovery.continuing: Refreshing the live stream and continuing in a new segment...
recovery.deleted: Recovery files and job data deleted.

deleteDialog.title: Delete recovery data?
deleteDialog.description: This permanently deletes the saved segments for “{{title}}”.

telemetry.title: Telemetry
telemetry.capacityDescription: Choose how many direct or Watchlist recordings may run at once (up to {{limit}}). Add different streamers to Watchlist, then enable or start them to record concurrently.

warnings.limitHigh: Multi-room mode is enabled. Watch CPU, disk, and bandwidth if recordings stutter.
warnings.multiRoomActive: Multiple rooms are recording now. Lower the room limit if CPU, disk, or bandwidth spikes.
